request.subject: ICON:ACTION:STAMPEDE

layers.text: Recolour the small red-orange tip of the snout and the small orange spots near the mouth to pale cream, so that nothing at all is red or orange. Change nothing else: keep the cream horns, the blue face and frill, the pale cream dust puffs, the pose, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
